The ten lepers, Luke 17. They cried, Jesus, Master, have mercy, and He sent them to show themselves to the priests. As they went, they were made clean, but one turned back, praising God with a loud voice, and that one was a Samaritan. Jesus asked, were there not ten cleansed, where are the nine? He notices gratitude. When God helps you today, say thank you out loud, even if it is only a whisper.
